# Tripofreak

> Free AI travel planner that builds personalised, day-by-day itineraries for any destination on earth — in under 30 seconds. No sign-up. No credit card. No catch.

Tripofreak is completely free to use. Users enter a destination, travel dates, budget, group type, and interests and receive a full structured trip plan instantly. Every recommendation includes an explanation. Every itinerary includes hidden gems, scam warnings, budget breakdowns, packing lists, local phrases, and emergency contacts.

## Product

- [Itinerary Generator](https://tripofreak.com): Enter any destination — get a full day-by-day itinerary in 30 seconds
- [My Trips](https://tripofreak.com/pages/my-trips.html): Save and revisit past itineraries (requires free Google sign-in)
- [Blog](https://tripofreak.com/pages/blog.html): Destination guides and travel intel for Indian travellers

## Features

- Day-by-day itinerary for any destination worldwide
- Freaky Finds: hidden gems and insider-only experiences most tourists never discover
- Insider Logic: reasoning behind every recommendation
- Budget breakdown: accommodation, food, transport, activities
- Risk alerts: scams, crowd timings, health warnings, hidden costs, weather traps
- Emergency contacts for every destination
- Packing list, local phrases, food guide, nearby day trips
- Arrival guide with transport directions
- Trip sharing via link and PDF download
- Works for solo travellers, couples, families, and groups

## Pricing

Free. No subscription. No freemium limit. No credit card required. Optional Google sign-in (free) enables trip saving.
